title: Map producer-v2 capability negotiation and diagnostics

findings.fact: PORT_CONTRACTS.producer remains kizuki.producer/v1. v2 binds only when expectedContract is explicitly kizuki.producer/v2. Default bind of a v2 descriptor is contract_mismatch before factory I/O.
Shipped kizuki.producer.model declares supports [model] on v1 minor 3. requirePortCapability(..., "model") succeeds; deterministic and unknown ids throw not_supported retryable=false.
RFC 0002 §3.7 names kizuki.producer.deterministic as an in-tree producer port. On this base it is the staging model-free floor, not a PortDescriptor a v2 consumer can negotiate.

invokeProducer asserts the compiled v1 contract. A v2 descriptor becomes usage_known=false unavailable/unavailable with transport diagnostic unavailable; produce() is not called. RFC 0003 B2 still owns runtime v2 emission.

V2 unavailable reasons are unavailable|timeout|network|credentials|http. Current model-producer strings llm unavailable|llm timeout|llm error fail v2 validateProduceResult as rejected/schema_invalid. B2 cannot reuse those reason strings.

unsupported_metadata is an LLM-adapter rejection of malformed named passive metadata, mapped by createModelProducerPort to rejected/schema_invalid with diagnostic {stage:response,rule:unsupported_metadata}. It is not a missing descriptor.supports bit.

PRODUCER_V2_CONTRACT is exported from packages/core/src/contracts/index.ts but not from the main @kizuki/core index. validateProduceResult and invokeProducer are not public index exports. No PRODUCER_V2_CAPABILITIES constant exists.
